title: Meta-Fair: AI-Assisted Fairness Testing of Large Language Models
findings: The framework detected various religious biases across different models. Specific findings include models treating Christian perspectives as a universal default for personal growth (Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking), showing inconsistencies when judging inter-religious criticism based on the specific religions involved (OpenAI o3-mini), and misinterpreting common names with religious origins (e.g., 'Krishna', 'Moses') as direct references to religious figures, which often led to invalid or biased responses.

measurement_description: Detection of bias and stereotypes in Large Language Model responses when religious identifiers (e.g., 'Catholic', 'Muslim'), names with religious connotations (e.g., 'Khadija', 'Moses'), or religious contexts (e.g., ranking religious texts, inter-religious criticism) are introduced into prompts.
